name: sift
description: Typed judgement calls for Claude Code: two primitives, judge and rank, under packs that grade issues, pull requests, plans, commits, releases and rules, a repository watch, tool output pruning and an outbound text gate, backed by TypeSafe Jev or the session's small model.

backend.title: Judge backend
backend.description: auto uses Jev when a key is present and the session's small model otherwise. off disables every judged feature and leaves only mechanical checks.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Jev key. Leave unset to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or the settings env block.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: TypeSafe model name sent with every Jev request.

jevBaseUrl.title: Jev endpoint
jevBaseUrl.description: System One endpoint. Change it only for a proxy or a compatible local server.

fallbackModel.title: Model backend alias
fallbackModel.description: Model used by the model backend, an alias such as haiku or a full id.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.description: Every module logs what it would have done and does nothing. Use it to calibrate thresholds before trusting them.

prune.title: Tool output pruning
prune.description: Score long tool outputs against the calling loop's task before the model reads them and drop chunks the judge marks unneeded. Each dropped run is replaced by a note with its line range and the call that gets it back; nothing is kept on disk. A Read is only ever cut at its tail, so its line numbers stay true. Targeted reads, repeats of pruned output and reads of paths the task names pass whole, and # sift: full or the prune tool keep output whole on purpose.

pruneFloorTokens.title: Prune floor (estimated tokens)
pruneFloorTokens.description: Tool outputs under this estimated size pass through untouched.

pruneKeepThreshold.title: Prune keep threshold
pruneKeepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a chunk is needed. Below it the chunk is replaced by an omission note.

pruneTools.title: Pruned tools
pruneTools.description: Comma separated tool names whose output is pruned. Bash and Read are supported.

watch.title: Repo watch
watch.description: Subscribe to the repositories in watchRepos at boot: poll them for issues, PRs, comments, edits, labels and CI, and deliver actionable events as prompts.

watchRepos.title: Watched repos
watchRepos.description: Comma separated owner/name list, each subscribed as a whole at boot when watch is on. Empty subscribes the session's own repo. More subscriptions, scoped to a PR, branch, run or tag, are added at runtime with the watch tool.

watchMinInterval.title: Watch poll interval when active (s)
watchMinInterval.description: Seconds between polls while the repo is changing.

watchMaxInterval.title: Watch poll interval when idle (s)
watchMaxInterval.description: Seconds between polls once the repo is idle. Idle polls are conditional requests and cost no API quota.

watchDelivery.title: Watch delivery
watchDelivery.description: prompt submits each actionable event as a user turn. log only writes transcript lines.

watchIgnoreSelf.title: Watch ignores own writes
watchIgnoreSelf.description: Events authored by the gh login this session runs as are deferred, not delivered.

watchIgnoreBots.title: Watch ignores bot accounts
watchIgnoreBots.description: Events authored by bot accounts are dropped.

watchCi.title: Watch CI events
watchCi.description: The CI filter of a subscription that sets none. settled delivers each open PR once when every check on its head has finished (pass or fail), and each completed run on a branch, tag or run subscription. failures delivers those verdicts and failed runs (on a whole repository, only those on protected or work pattern branches). all delivers every completed run as well, none delivers no CI.

watchTriage.title: Watch triage with the judge
watchTriage.description: Run the triage pack on issue and PR events. Off delivers everything the rules do not defer.

watchDeferMaxAgeHours.title: Deferred event max age (h)
watchDeferMaxAgeHours.description: A deferred event older than this is delivered on its own so nothing waits forever.

watchStallHours.title: CI stall interval (h)
watchStallHours.description: A PR head whose checks have not all finished within this many hours is delivered once as ci stalled, naming the pending checks.

grade.title: Grading tools
grade.description: Register the grade (packs: issue, pr, plan, commit, rules, release, locate, and any under .sift/packs), judge (typed questions over one state) and rank (the same questions over many items) tools.

config.title: Conventions
config.description: Conventions in the shape of .sift/config.json, as inline JSON or a path relative to the repo root. Three layers apply in order, field by field: the neutral defaults, then this option or, when it is empty, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sift/config.json (~/.config/sift/config.json) if it exists, then each repo's own .sift/config.json. Empty with no global file uses the defaults: no commit format, version or changelog checks.

gateOutbound.title: Outbound text gate
gateOutbound.description: Refuse forge writes made from the shell (gh pr, issue and release writes with text, and the gh api calls that make them) in favour of the post tool, which judges the text by the rules of the repository it names. Before other text leaves the session through a channel (Discord messages by default, more under outbound.channels in the config), check the channel's length limit and judge the text against the rule documents of the repository checked out where the calling subagent was spawned, else the session's. A broken rule denies the call, an unclear one logs.

classify.title: Answer engine classifications
classify.description: Serve the engine's own model.classify calls from the judge backend.
